items.title: Joseph "Fan" Bourgeau Interview, 1959-09-24
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...I have to check with Tom and Mark.

ctx.x: No, I don't know where he's at. He had been up in… He's around Baconda Street somewhere.
Well, around Tom Alberts there next door. I don't think he's there now, somebody told me. I'm not sure, I have to check with Tom and Mark.
Now there's, now I don't know if you know this guy, he's, what is this boy's name? His name is Paul Anderson. I think his name is Paul Anderson. He's a songster.
